themes.topic: SK Hynix Q2'26 Earnings & HBM Outlook
themes.summary: SK Hynix reported Q2'26 operating profit below estimates but showed significant YoY growth in revenue and profit, driven by HBM and AI server DRAM. themes.topic: Seagate Q4 FY2026 Earnings & HDD Pricing Power
themes.summary: Seagate reported strong Q4 FY2026 earnings, with data-center revenue up 57% YoY and exabyte shipments up 43%, indicating a demand-constrained, price-led market. The company achieved its 13th consecutive quarter of gross margin expansion, with nearline capacity sold out through 2027, suggesting significant pricing power that should flow to Western Digital.

themes.topic: Corning Q2'26 Earnings & AI Data Center Fiber Demand

Despite a lower Q3 guide, management is enthusiastic about accelerating orders and long-term agreements, with supply constraints, not weak demand, limiting near-term growth for optical fiber, the "circulatory system of AI infrastructure."

themes.topic: Hyperscaler GPU Rental Spot Prices & AI Capex Funding
themes.summary: Hyperscaler credit spreads are widening, but GPU rental spot prices are at least 2x higher than contracted rates, implying hyperscalers are underearning and operating cash flow will accelerate to fund AI capex. This suggests that concerns about hyperscaler creditworthiness are overblown, as contract repricing will boost cash flow.
